data.name: SIM_EXTRAPOLATION_SCHALTER

data.name: SIM_EXTRAPOLATION_TOOLTIP
data.value:
If the source temperature falls below the lowest data point of the heat pump characteristic curve, the curve is extended linearly.
With the tick (default): extrapolation takes place and the run records this as a note. This corresponds exactly to the previous behaviour - up to package 8 the engine asked at this point.
Without the tick: the simulation aborts and names the affected unit. Useful if extrapolated characteristic values should not enter a result; the curve then has to be supplemented with lower data points.

data.name: SIMQ_PUFFER_HINWEIS_KASKADE
data.value:
Cascade (boiler): the boiler draws its inlet temperature from the selected buffer storage instead of from the system return.
Share = (storage flow − boiler return) / (boiler flow − boiler return)
The fuel demand drops by this share of the useful heat; the withdrawal is at the same time a discharge of the storage. If the storage delivers less, fuel covers the shortfall. The boiler is computed after the generator that charges the storage.

data.name: SIMQ_PUFFER_HINWEIS_KASKADE_KURZ
data.value:
The boiler raises the temperature from the storage level to its own flow level — no longer from the system return.
The evaporator parameters of the heat pump therefore do not apply here.

data.name: SIMQ_PUFFER_HINWEIS_QUELLWAERME
data.value:
The heat pump extracts the evaporator heat (heat generated − electricity input) from the storage every hour.
If the storage is empty, the output of the heat pump is limited; the regeneration recharges the storage continuously.

Semicolon, comma, tabulator and vertical bar are accepted as field separators; a single-column file needs none. A header line is allowed and is detected. data.name: KI_HINWEIS_TITEL
data.value: Notice on the use of the AI assistant

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_EINLEITUNG
data.value: The AI assistant does not answer your questions itself. It transmits them to a service operated by Google (Gemini interface); processing takes place there, outside this application. What is sent is described below in full.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_UEBERTRAGEN
data.value: • Your question, verbatim. The text you type is sent unchanged – including any names, addresses or other details you put into it yourself. • The name of the area you are currently working in (for example “Report” or “Cost-effectiveness”). It comes from a fixed list of generic area names; project, customer and plant names are not part of that list. • Extracts from the built-in knowledge base – fixed texts about operating the program.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_UEB_AKTIONEN
data.value: Additionally, when “Allow actions” is switched on

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_AKTIONEN
data.value: • The tool catalogue: the names of the permitted actions, their parameters and the explanations of those parameters. Read actions run straight away; actions that change data are carried out only after your explicit confirmation in each individual case. Before the first change of a session the program makes a dated backup copy of the database, supplied catalogues and write-protected records are excluded, and nothing is deleted. • The results of executed read actions. Identifiers contained in them – project, variant and plant names – are replaced by placeholders beforehand (“Name 1”); figures, units and keys are sent unchanged.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_NICHT
data.value: Raw database content, customer master data, simulation time series and file paths are not sent. The API key is passed in a request header and does not appear in the address that is called.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_EMPFAENGER
data.value: The recipient is Google as the operator of the Gemini interface. The provider’s terms in force at the time govern the nature and extent of the processing carried out there; under those terms, content submitted within the free tier is used for product improvement. A paid plan is intended for productive use. Keywords from your question are sent to wiki.epos-plan.de to search the online documentation.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_UEB_BEACHTEN
data.value: What you need to bear in mind

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_BEACHTEN
data.value: Do not put anything into your question that must not leave the application – in particular no personal data and nothing subject to confidentiality. “What is sent?” in the chat window shows you the exact text that would go out, before every request.

data.name: KI_HINWEIS_VERANTWORTUNG
data.value: The operator of this installation is responsible for the use of the AI assistant. Whether transmission to the provider requires a data processing agreement or another contractual basis is for the operator to examine. This notice describes the actual data flow only; it does not replace that examination and makes no statement as to whether the use is permissible in a given case.

data.name: BILANZ_HINWEIS_DIN
data.value: On 01/01/2027 the displacement electricity mix ceases to exist without replacement; the GModG replaces the electricity credit method with an assessment under DIN EN 15316-4-5. What is implemented is the loss of the credit, not the allocation procedure of that standard — its text is not part of the factual basis of this project.

data.name: BILANZ_HINWEIS_SUBSTITUTION
data.value: The substitution factor is a methodological choice, not a legal requirement: the Federal Environment Agency derives it for renewable electricity (photovoltaics), not for CHP. There is no official replacement for the displacement electricity mix.

data.name: BILANZ_HINWEIS_BIOMASSE
data.value: The balancing convention for biomass contradicts itself across the rulebooks: the BEHG, GEG/GModG, the UBA emission balance and BAFA set biogenic combustion CO₂ to zero, the UBA CO₂ calculator uses 365 g/kWh. Bio heating oil blends are not affected — their biogenic share is already contained in the catalogue factor and is not held as a separate quantity in the data model.

data.name: BILANZ_DLG_NACHWEIS
data.value: Sustainability certificate under section 8 EBeV 2030 available

data.name: BILANZ_DLG_HINWEIS
data.value: Balancing: the balance year determines which law applies. Without an entry, 2026 applies — the emission balance then works with an electricity credit exactly as before. From balance year 2027 the displacement electricity mix ceases to exist without replacement; anyone who still wants a credit chooses it here explicitly, and the report presents it as a methodological choice. The sustainability certificate only affects liquid biomass (rapeseed oil, animal fats) — solid biomass and biogas are not BEHG fuels.

data.value: The parameters apply to the master project and all variants of the comparison group; generator groups appear only if the generator type occurs in the group (hidden values are preserved). Energy and electricity prices come from the cost screen. Surcharges: default OFF — switched on, energy costs typically rise by about a third (proposed values totalling 11.746 ct/kWh). They are maintained per energy carrier in the cost screen; WHETHER the economic calculation applies them is decided in the energy carrier dialog (electricity) — the checkbox here only shows the choice.

data.name: WPAR_HINWEIS_KWKG
data.value: CHP Act: cap override 0 = degressive full-load-hour scale 2025 from the commissioning year; eligible only with a cut-off date up to 31/12/2026 and realisation by the end of the 4th following year. Taxes: without an explicit entry NO credit arises — § 53 and § 53a are mutually exclusive, the rates and limits come from the catalogue “Statutory parameters”. The annual utilisation rate is needed only for § 53a (threshold 70 %).

data.name: WPAR_SZ_HINWEIS
data.value: The expected case still uses the project parameters above — that column is display only. Best and worst deviate from it: interest rate and price escalations apply in absolute terms, investment and revenues as a change in percent, the service life as a change in years; + always means more or longer. A best/worst value maintained on a cost item takes PRECEDENCE — the flat deviation only applies where none is given. “Defaults” restores the proposal (interest rate and price escalations ∓ 1 percentage point, investment ∓ 10 %, revenues ± 10 %, service life ± 2 years). The default for p_I is spread around the p_I IN EFFECT for the expected case: if p_I follows the operating rate — the regular case — that is exactly the p_B of this scenario. Review period and change in quantities have no default: an empty field means “as expected”, the placeholder shows the value then used. A longer review period is not automatically the favourable one — where costs dominate, it lowers the net present value. “Defaults” clears all eighteen fields of the table; the feed-in tariffs per scenario are maintained with the ± button at their field.

data.name: SIMERG_INFO_BHKW
data.value:
Heat-led (standard) The CHP unit follows the space heating and DHW demand. The electricity generated covers the own demand; surplus is fed into the public grid.
Electricity-led (economic) The CHP unit follows the electricity demand. Surplus heat is buffered in the storage as long as storage capacity is available; beyond that, surplus heat is dumped.
Without feed-in (zero export) The CHP unit never generates more electricity than the current own demand. The unit throttles back immediately as soon as the electricity demand is covered or the heat storage is full. No grid feed-in.

data.value: Projekt-, Kunden- und Simulationsdaten werden ausschließlich lokal auf diesem Rechner gespeichert und nicht an INEKON übertragen. Lizenzierung: Beim Aktivieren einer Lizenz, beim Anfordern einer Testversion und beim Lösen eines Gerätes von der Lizenz werden Lizenzschlüssel, E-Mail-Adresse, eine anonyme Gerätekennung (Geräte-Hash), die Programmversion und der Zeitpunkt des Vorgangs an den Lizenzserver von epos-plan.de übertragen. data.name: STROMGL_HINWEIS_FORMAT
data.value: File format: CSV or text file (Excel .xlsx/.xlsm/.xls as well) holding one year of load data — 8,760 hourly values or 35,040 quarter-hourly values, in chronological order starting on 1 January, one value per line. Semicolon, comma, tabulator and vertical bar are accepted as field separators; a single-column file needs none. A header line is allowed and is detected. Decimal separator comma or point, no thousands separator. Values as power in kW or as energy in kWh per interval — the unit is asked for before reading and converted to kW. A time stamp column is permitted but not required. The name of the load profile is the file name without its extension.

data.name: WIRT_SZ_QUELLEN

Investment-linked operating costs follow the investment deviation of the scenario. The capital cost escalation p_I indexes the replacement investments and the price basis of the residual value; if it is not maintained separately it follows the operating rate (p_B), in the scenario at the same distance of 1 percentage point as p_E and p_B.

data.name: KI_DIALOGDATEN_FRAGE
data.value:
The assistant is about to send the values of the dialog you currently have open to the model provider, together with your question.
Only the fields listed in the dialog catalogue are transmitted — display name, unit and the value currently shown in the dialog. Project name, customer name and the database itself are not included.
Before every request you can read literally what goes out via “What is sent?”, and the switch “Send field values” can be turned off at any time. You can withdraw this consent in the assistant settings.
Do you want to allow this?

data.name: FLOTTE_OPT_SUCHE_AN
data.value: Search for the economically best size

data.name: FLOTTE_OPT_FEINRASTER
data.value: Phase 2: fine grid around the coarse optimum

data.name: FLOTTE_OPT_KEINE_EINHEIT
data.value: Without a storage unit there is nothing to vary — step 1 creates one.

data.name: FLOTTE_OPT_RASTER_ZUVIEL
data.value: The grid exceeds the limit „maximum design candidates". The run is rejected and never truncated: narrow the range or the step width, switch off the fine grid, or raise the limit in step 2.

data.name: FLOTTE_OPT_RASTER_UNGUELTIG
data.value: The search space is incomplete — a range is empty, negative or has no step width.

data.name: FLOTTE_ED_AUSGLEICH_ERL
data.value: The storage rarely ends the year at the state of charge it started from. The balancing value prices the difference end energy − start energy and books it as a correction in the annual balance — positive when the storage ends fuller. The proposal is the mean purchase price of the data source; a value changed by hand is kept.

data.name: FLOTTE_ED_RESTWERT_ERL
data.value: An amount booked as income at the END of the project lifetime and discounted into the net present value — on top of the residual values of the individual units. Meant for everything that belongs to the study rather than to a unit: grid connection, building, site, resale as a package.

data.name: FLOTTE_ED_KANDIDATEN_ERL
data.value: Upper limit for the number of grid points the optimisation computes — coarse and fine grid together. Every candidate is a complete annual run across all project years. If the grid exceeds the limit, the run is rejected and never truncated.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_SCHRITT_ERL
data.value: Which of the five steps of the flow bar is currently in front: storage, data & costs, operating strategy, optimisation or result.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_METHODE_ERL
data.value: What the next run varies: only evaluate, search for the size, or search for the unit count. Exactly one kind is varied per run.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_SUCHE_ERL
data.value: Yes: the next run scans the search space and names the economically best size. No: it only evaluates the fleet configured in step 1.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_FEINRASTER_ERL
data.value: After the coarse grid a second, narrower grid is computed around the best coarse point — on the size axis only, in steps of one ninth of the step width. It only wins on a strictly better net present value.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_MAXKAND_ERL
data.value: Upper limit for the number of grid points across both phases. If the grid exceeds it, the run is rejected and never truncated.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_KANDZAHL_ERL
data.value: How many candidates the configured search space yields — coarse grid plus the fine grid upper bound. Every candidate is a complete annual run.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_BESTWERT_ERL
data.value: Net present value of the best candidate of the last search against the variant without additional storage.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_BESTKAP_ERL
data.value: Capacity of the fleet of the best candidate of the last search.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_BESTERSPARNIS_ERL
data.value: Operating saving of the best candidate WITHOUT capital service — the figure that allows a comparison with the spreadsheet.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA_BESTPHASE_ERL
data.value: Which phase of the search the best candidate comes from: coarse (the first grid) or fine (the narrower grid around the coarse optimum).

data.name: ADM_SET_MSG_FARBE_UNGUELTIG
data.value: “{0}” is not a colour in the #RRGGBB notation.

data.name: ADM_SET_HINT_NEUE_PROJEKTE_KUEHLUNG
data.value: Applies only to newly created projects. Existing projects keep their setting; a copied project takes over the setting of its source.

data.name: ADM_SET_MSG_KUEHLUNG_FEHLER
data.value: The setting “Create new projects with cooling” could not be saved. Error: {0}

data.name: KI_DLG_HKP_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The name of the boiler selected in the project — shown from the project list, not editable.

data.name: KI_DLG_HKP_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: Flow temperature of this boiler in the project in °C, whole number; empty means “not specified”.

data.name: KI_DLG_HKP_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: Return temperature of this boiler in the project in °C, whole number; empty means “not specified”.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKW_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The name of the CHP module selected in the project — shown from the project list, not editable.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKW_GRENZLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: Lower modulation limit of this module as a percentage of rated output; 0 means “project default from the settings”.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKW_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: Flow temperature of this CHP module in the project in °C, whole number; empty means “not specified”.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKW_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: Return temperature of this CHP module in the project in °C, whole number; empty means “not specified”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPP_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The name of the buffer tank selected in the project — shown from the project list, not editable.

data.name: KI_DLG_STSP_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The name of the battery storage unit selected in the project — shown from the project list, not editable.

data.name: KI_DLG_SK_ANZAHL_ERL
data.value: Number of collector modules of this system, whole number from 0; together with the module area it yields the aperture area shown.

data.name: KI_DLG_SK_NEIGUNG_ERL
data.value: Tilt of the collector area against the horizontal in degrees, 0 to 90 (0 = horizontal).

data.name: KI_DLG_SK_AZIMUT_ERL
data.value: Orientation of the collector area in degrees, 0 = south; negative values towards east, positive towards west.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The name of the selected heat pump — shown from the device list; renaming is done in the heat pump management.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: Flow temperature of the system in °C; selectable are the steps for which the device has characteristic curves.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: Return temperature of the system in °C, whole number and freely editable; the values shown are a suggestion.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_NUTZUNGSDAUER_ERL
data.value: Service life of this system in years; it is mandatory — without it the OK button reports.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_HEIZSTAB_ERL
data.value: Should the immersion heater of this heat pump be included in the run? Yes requires a stored heater output.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SPERRUNG_ERL
data.value: Does the utility block the heat pump at times? Yes makes both blocking times effective.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SPERRZEIT_VON_ERL
data.value: Start of the daily blocking time in hours; mandatory — without it the OK button reports.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SPERRZEIT_BIS_ERL
data.value: End of the daily blocking time in hours; mandatory — without it the OK button reports.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BIVALENT_ERL
data.value: Does the heat pump work bivalently, that is together with a second heat generator? Yes requires an operating mode.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BETRIEBSART_ERL
data.value: The operating mode of bivalent operation: “Alternativbetrieb”, “Parallelbetrieb” or “Teilparallelbetrieb”. With alternative and semi-parallel operation the bivalence temperature takes effect.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_ABSCHALTPUNKT_ERL
data.value: The bivalence temperature in °C — the outdoor temperature below which the second heat generator takes over; effective only in alternative and semi-parallel operation.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the device as held in the project copy; free text.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: Free text about the device of the project copy; it affects no calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_TYP_ERL
data.value: The heat pump type of the project copy (for example air/water or brine/water); selectable are the entries of the form.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_REGELUNG_ERL
data.value: The output stages of the device (for example single-stage or modulating); selectable are the entries of the form.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_AUFSTELLUNG_ERL
data.value: The installation type of the device (for example indoor or outdoor); selectable are the entries of the form.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BAUJAHR_ERL
data.value: The year of manufacture of the device as a four-digit year.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_NENNLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The rated thermal output of the device in kW, whole number; it belongs to the project copy, not to the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_HEIZSTAB_KW_ERL
data.value: The electrical output of the immersion heater in kW; without it the heater cannot be included in the run.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_KUEHLLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The cooling capacity of the device in kW; decimals are allowed, empty means “not maintained”.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_MODULKOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The device costs in euros — display only; they are maintained in the cost management, not on this form.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_MODELL_ERL
data.value: The two entries of the drop-down list: “Simple” = isotropic irradiance and linear temperature response, “Extended” = Hay-Davies, low-light model and inverter characteristic curve. The inverter is calculated in both models.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_WR_WIRKUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The inverter efficiency as a factor between 0 and 1; empty means 0.95. Editable only in the simple model — in the extended one the characteristic curve applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_SYSTEMVERLUSTE_ERL
data.value: Flat-rate system losses of the plant in percent, 0 to 100; empty means 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_MIT_WR_ERL
data.value: Yes = with inverter, that is with catalogue, strings, characteristic curve and clipping; No = simplified with flat rates.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_ERL
data.value: The name of this string, for example “South roof”; if empty the form shows the rank number.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_GERAET_ERL
data.value: Which physical device of this type carries the string, whole number from 1; empty means 1.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_MPPT_ERL
data.value: The MPPT input of the device the string is connected to, whole number from 1; empty means 1.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_REIHE_ERL
data.value: The number of modules connected in series in this string, whole number from 1; without it the string counts no modules.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_PARALLEL_ERL
data.value: The number of strings connected in parallel in this row, whole number from 1; empty means 1.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_NEIGUNG_ERL
data.value: Tilt of this sub-array in degrees; empty inherits the tilt of the plant.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_STRANG_AZIMUT_ERL
data.value: Orientation of this sub-array in degrees, 0 = south; empty inherits the azimuth of the plant.

data.name: KI_DLG_MASKE_PSPV
data.value: Manage buffer tanks of the project

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The name of this buffer tank in the project; it must be given.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_VOLUMEN_ERL
data.value: Total volume of the tank in litres; it must be greater than 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_VERLUSTE_ERL
data.value: Standby losses of the tank in kilowatt hours per day; empty counts as 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: Flow temperature of the tank in °C; it must be above the return temperature.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: Return temperature of the tank in °C; it must be below the flow temperature.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_SCHWELLE_EIN_ERL
data.value: State of charge in percent at which the generators start recharging the tank.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_SCHWELLE_AUS_ERL
data.value: State of charge in percent at which charging stops; it must be above the switch-on threshold.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_SCHWELLE_NACHRANG_ERL
data.value: State of charge in percent from which subordinate generators may charge as well.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_MINDESTFUELLSTAND_ERL
data.value: Share in percent kept in the tank as an emergency reserve and never discharged; 0 is valid.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_SCHICHTEN_ERL
data.value: Number of calculation layers of the tank model; 1 means “one volume without stratification”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_HOEHE_ERL
data.value: Height of the tank in metres — only for the stratified model; empty means “the default applies”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_LAMBDA_ERL
data.value: Effective thermal conductivity between the layers in W/(m·K); it governs how fast the stratification decays.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_T_NUTZ_BW_ERL
data.value: Temperature in °C from which the water is usable for domestic hot water.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_LADELEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: Maximum charging power of the tank in kW; empty means “unlimited”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_ENTLADELEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: Maximum discharging power of the tank in kW; empty means “unlimited”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_ENTLADEPRIO_ERL
data.value: Order in which the tanks of the project are discharged (1 = first); 0 means “automatic”.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_SONDE_ERL
data.value: The source system: on = borehole probe (length per probe and count apply), off = horizontal collector (laying depth and area apply). The choice only locks; the other branch keeps its values.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_TIEFE_ERL
data.value: Laying depth of the horizontal collector in metres; it governs damping and phase shift of the source temperature.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_FLAECHE_ERL
data.value: Area occupied by the horizontal collector in square metres; it enters the design check to VDI 4640 part 2.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_LAENGE_ERL
data.value: Length of EACH borehole probe in metres — not the total of all probes.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_ANZAHL_ERL
data.value: Number of borehole probes; at least 1.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_SPREIZUNG_ERL
data.value: Usable temperature spread of the source in kelvin; it must be greater than 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_KLIMAZONE_ERL
data.value: Climate zone of the site, 1 to 15; 0 means “not assigned”. It supplies the ground temperatures as long as no climate data of the project are available.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_TEMPERATUR_ERL
data.value: Heat pump only: temperature in °C at which the source reaches the evaporator.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_SPREIZUNG_ERL
data.value: Heat pump only: usable temperature spread of the source in kelvin; it must be greater than 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_REGENERATION_ERL
data.value: Heat pump only: power in kW with which the source recharges itself.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_UNBEGRENZT_ERL
data.value: Heat pump only: the source counts as unlimited; the tank content then does not limit the withdrawal.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_FEST_ERL
data.value: Boiler only: on = flow and return are fixed values, off = they are derived from the plant.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: Boiler only, with fixed values: the flow temperature in °C; it must be above the return.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: Boiler only, with fixed values: the return temperature in °C; it must be below the flow.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_ANSCHLUSSHOEHE_ERL
data.value: Height of the source withdrawal in the tank, 0 = bottom to 1 = top; empty means “top”.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_BEZEICHNUNG_ERL
data.value: The name of the source profile; without it nothing is saved.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: Free text for the source profile; it may stay empty.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_BETRIEBSART_ERL
data.value: The raster of the profile: month (12 values), day (365 values) or hour (8760 values). A change keeps what fits and fills the rest with the default.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_ZIEL_ERL
data.value: Where this sink delivers its heat: into the heating circuit or into a buffer tank. The fields below follow the target.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_BEDARFSART_ERL
data.value: Heating circuit only: which demand is covered (space heating, domestic hot water, process heat).

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_LADEPRIO_ERL
data.value: Buffer tank only: in which order this tank is charged; 0 means “as the tank specifies”.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_LADEPRIO_PV_ERL
data.value: Rank 1 only and only with photovoltaics: a different order while PV surplus is available; 0 means “unchanged”.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_LADEGRENZE_AKTIV_ERL
data.value: On = this sink charges only up to its own upper limit instead of the switch-off threshold of the tank. Switching it on proposes 70 %.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_LADEGRENZE_ERL
data.value: The own upper charging limit of this sink in percent; it applies only while the switch is on.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_HOEHE_AKTIV_ERL
data.value: On = this sink feeds into the tank at its own height. Switching it on proposes 1 (top).

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_HOEHE_ERL
data.value: The own feed-in height in the tank, 0 = bottom to 1 = top; it applies only while the switch is on.

data.name: KI_DLG_KKONF_BEREITSCHAFT_ERL
data.value: Standby operation of the boilers in hours per year — a value of the PROJECT, not of this boiler.

data.name: KI_DLG_KKONF_BETRIEBSART_ERL
data.value: Operating mode of the CHP units in the project: 0 = heat-led, 1 = power-led, 2 = without grid feed-in.

data.name: KI_DLG_KKONF_GRENZE_ERL
data.value: Lower modulation limit of the CHP modules in percent of rated power — a value of the PROJECT; 0 counts as 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_LESEPUNKT_ERL
data.value: On = the heat pump reads the storage state at the start of the hour (conservative), off = at the end of the hour. The switch applies to the whole project.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_SOCMIN_ERL
data.value: Lower state of charge of the battery in percent; below it nothing is discharged.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_SOCMAX_ERL
data.value: Upper state of charge of the battery in percent; above it nothing is charged.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_LADELEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: Charging and discharging power of the battery system in kW — a device value; editable only with exactly one battery system.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_KAPAZITAET_ERL
data.value: Rated capacity of the battery system in kWh — a device value; editable only with exactly one battery system.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_LADESCHWELLE_ERL
data.value: Price threshold in cents per kilowatt hour below which the battery charges from the grid.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_BETRIEBSART_ERL
data.value: The control value of the battery operating mode — not the display text of the drop-down list.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_BERECHNUNGSART_ERL
data.value: The control value of the calculation mode. It also decides whether compatibility mode and peak target are selectable at all.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_PEAKZIEL_ERL
data.value: Target threshold of peak shaving in kW; 0 means “not maintained”.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_PEAKADAPTIV_ERL
data.value: On = the target threshold tracks itself during the run instead of using the entered value.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_KOMPAT_ERL
data.value: Compatibility mode of continuous use — it calculates like the Excel template; selectable only for that calculation mode.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_LADEN_PV_ERL
data.value: On = the battery charges from the photovoltaic surplus.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_LADEN_BHKW_ERL
data.value: On = the battery charges from the CHP surplus.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_NETZENTLADUNG_ERL
data.value: On = the battery may discharge into the grid.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_STROMGEFUEHRT_ERL
data.value: Power-led CHP operation for the battery — visible but permanently locked; read only.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_KAPITALZINS_ERL
data.value: Discount rate of the battery economics in percent.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_NUTZUNGSDAUER_ERL
data.value: Service life of the battery system in years.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_LEISTUNGSPREIS_ERL
data.value: Demand charge of the grid operator in euro per kilowatt and year; it values the peak that was shaved.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_NETZAUFSCHLAG_ERL
data.value: Surcharge on grid-charged energy in cents per kilowatt hour.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_PREISQUELLE_ERL
data.value: The control value of the price source. It changes both the label and the content of the series selection below.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_AUFSCHLAG_ERL
data.value: On = the surcharge is applied to the selected price series.

data.name: KI_FELD_WAHL_LEER
data.value: The field “{0}” currently offers no selection; it cannot be set.

data.name: KI_FELD_WAHL_UNBEKANNT
data.value: “{1}” is not an entry of “{0}”. Available are: {2}.

data.name: KI_FELD_WAHL_MEHRDEUTIG
data.value: “{1}” matches several entries of “{0}”: {2}. Please be more precise.

data.name: KI_FELD_WAHL_SCHLUESSEL
data.value: The entry “{1}” of “{0}” cannot be set as a value (key “{2}”).

data.name: KI_FELD_MEHRDEUTIG
data.value: The field name “{0}” matches several fields in “{1}”: {2}. Please name it precisely.

data.name: KI_DLG_HK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The boiler name of the catalogue record; the boiler appears under it in the list.

data.name: KI_DLG_HK_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the boiler; purely descriptive, it does not enter any calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_HK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: Free descriptive text for the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_HK_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier of the boiler; it decides which efficiency is used.

data.name: KI_DLG_HK_BRENNWERT_ERL
data.value: Yes = the boiler is calculated as a condensing boiler.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSP_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the storage tank in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSP_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the storage tank; purely descriptive.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSP_SPEICHERTYP_ERL
data.value: The design of the storage tank (solar, buffer, combined).

data.name: KI_DLG_PSP_VERLUSTE_ERL
data.value: The heat loss of the ready-to-operate storage tank over one day.

data.name: KI_DLG_WP_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the heat pump in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_WP_KUEHLLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The cooling capacity of the catalogue record; here a read-only display, it is changed at the plant.

data.name: KI_DLG_HKP_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The fuel variant of the plant; it decides the price and the emissions of the boiler.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKW_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The fuel variant of the plant; it decides the price and the emissions of the module.

data.name: KI_DLG_STSP_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier of the storage unit; it decides the price and the emissions of the electricity drawn.

data.name: KI_DLG_PV_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier of the plant; it decides the price and the emissions of the electricity generated.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier of the heat pump; it decides the price and the emissions of the drive power.

data.name: KI_DLG_QERD_BODENTYP_ERL
data.value: The subsoil at the site. It supplies the thermal conductivity and heat capacity of the ground and thus determines the source temperature and the design to VDI 4640.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPUF_PUFFER_ERL
data.value: The buffer tank of the project that serves as the heat source. Only the tanks of this project are available; “Create buffer tank…” adds a new one.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_PROFIL_ERL
data.value: The stored source profile the screen loads. “New profile” starts an empty set; a loaded profile brings along its operating mode, name and values.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_MONATSWERTE_ERL
data.value: The twelve monthly mean temperatures of the heat source, January to December – only in the “month” operating mode; each value is mandatory when saving.

data.name: KI_DLG_QPROF_NICHT_MONAT
data.value: The monthly values apply in the “month” operating mode; “{0}” is selected. Switch the operating mode first.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSEN_SPEICHER_ERL
data.value: The buffer tank this sink charges. It exists only if the target is a tank slot; each tank may be a target only once.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_NUTZUNG_HEIZUNG_ERL
data.value: The tank supplies the heating. The usage is a multiple choice: heating, domestic hot water and process heat can be ticked individually or together.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_NUTZUNG_BW_ERL
data.value: The tank supplies the domestic hot water. Only then does the domestic hot water usable temperature apply.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_NUTZUNG_PROZESS_ERL
data.value: The tank supplies the process heat.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_ENTNAHME_HEIZUNG_ERL
data.value: The height at which the heating draws from the tank: 0 is at the very bottom, 1 at the very top. Empty means “top”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_ENTNAHME_BW_ERL
data.value: The height at which the domestic hot water draws from the tank: 0 is at the very bottom, 1 at the very top. Empty means “top”.

data.name: KI_DLG_PSPV_ENTNAHME_PROZESS_ERL
data.value: The height at which the process heat draws from the tank: 0 is at the very bottom, 1 at the very top. Empty means “top”.

data.name: KI_DLG_KKONF_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier of the heat pump; it determines the price and emissions of the drive electricity.

data.name: KI_DLG_SIM_SP_PREISREIHE_ERL
data.value: The price series the storage unit's electricity tariff is calculated from; it changes with the price source.

data.name: KI_DLG_KV_BEMESSUNG_ERL
data.value: The reference quantity of the item; it decides what the rate refers to.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_VERWENDUNG_ERL
data.value: The filter of the column “Use” of the catalogue list: residential or commercial and other. Empty shows both.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_FILTER_ART_ERL
data.value: The filter of the column “Building category” of the catalogue list; the list shows the records whose category contains the value. Empty shows every category.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_FILTER_BAUJAHR_ERL
data.value: The filter of the column “Building age class” of the catalogue list. Empty shows every class.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_SUCHE_ERL
data.value: The search over all columns of the catalogue list; several terms must all occur, asterisk and question mark are wildcards.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the marked record — of the project building or of the catalogue record, depending on the marking.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_ART_ERL
data.value: The building type of the marked record.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The description of the marked record.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_WOHNFLAECHE_ERL
data.value: The living or usable area of the marked record as shown on the screen. It is changed with the “Change…” button.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEB_ANGABEART_ERL
data.value: The kind of entry: living area, or a consumption figure the area is derived from.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_BEDARFSART_ERL
data.value: The kind of entry for this building; it determines the unit and the calculation path of the figure beside it.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_WERT_ERL
data.value: The heat demand or the living area, in the unit named by the kind of entry.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_NUTZUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The annual efficiency of the boiler as a fraction, e.g. 0.85 for 85 %. It is only needed for a fuel figure.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_DEZENTRAL_ERL
data.value: Is domestic hot water produced locally in the building? Then it stays out of the heating demand.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the building whose figures the screen carries.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_ART_ERL
data.value: The building type from the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The description from the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_BAUJAHR_ERL
data.value: The building age class of the building in plain text.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBW_ANGABEART_ERL
data.value: The kind of entry as shown in the header — even when the drop-down list no longer carries it.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the catalogue record. In catalogue management it selects the record the screen loads; otherwise it names the record that is written.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBA_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the selected building – read-only. The field “satz” selects another record; a record gets a new name via “Duplicate...”.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_TYP_ERL
data.value: The building type from the type catalogue; it brings along the daily consumption profiles.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: Free text for the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_ART_ERL
data.value: The building type, for example detached house or office building.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_BAUALTERSKLASSE_ERL
data.value: The building age class of the building, a construction period from A (up to 1859) to M (from 2021); it determines the defaults of the components. If the year of construction is set, the class follows it and cannot be chosen.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_BAUJAHR_ERL
data.value: The year of construction of the building, 1500 to 2100; empty = unknown. If it is set, it determines the building age class; it does not change the calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_ENERGIESTANDARD_ERL
data.value: The energy standard of the building if its envelope is better than the minimum standard of its building age class (Efficiency House, Passive House …); empty = none. Efficiency House 115/100 and 85 exist for residential buildings only. It determines the component defaults before the class; it does not change the calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_VERWENDUNG_ERL
data.value: Residential building, or commercial and other; the use decides which list the building types come from.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_BAUART_ERL
data.value: The construction class: light, heavy or very heavy. It updates the thermal mass derived from class and living area.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_WOHNFLAECHE_ERL
data.value: The total living or usable area of the building.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FLAECHE_NUTZER_ERL
data.value: The area per occupant; it determines the number of people and thus the internal loads.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_WAERMEGEWINNE_ERL
data.value: The internal heat gains from people and appliances.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_DURCHLASSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The total solar energy transmittance of the windows as a fraction, for example 0.4.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_RAUMHOEHE_ERL
data.value: The mean clear room height; it enters the heated air volume.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FF_OSTWEST_ERL
data.value: The window area facing east and west together.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_AUSSENWAND_ERL
data.value: The external wall area without the windows.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_GRUNDFLAECHE_ERL
data.value: The floor area against ground or unheated basement.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_SONST_FLAECHEN_ERL
data.value: The remaining heat-transferring areas that belong to none of the other groups.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_U_AUSSENWAND_ERL
data.value: The thermal transmittance of the external wall.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_U_FENSTER_ERL
data.value: The thermal transmittance of the windows.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_U_DACH_ERL
data.value: The thermal transmittance of the roof area.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_U_GRUND_ERL
data.value: The thermal transmittance of the floor area.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_U_SONSTIGES_ERL
data.value: The thermal transmittance of the remaining areas.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_SOLL_TAG_ERL
data.value: The set room temperature during the day.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_NACHT_ERL
data.value: The night-time setback of the room temperature.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_MAX_TEMPERATUR_ERL
data.value: The highest admissible room temperature; a value below 1 counts as 24 degrees.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_WOCHENENDE_ERL
data.value: The weekend setback; a value above 0 switches weekend operation on.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_SOLL_FERIEN_ERL
data.value: The set temperature during holiday periods; a value above 0 switches holiday operation on.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FENSTER_WAND_ERL
data.value: The thermal bridge loss coefficient of the window-to-wall joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_WAND_DACH_ERL
data.value: The thermal bridge loss coefficient of the wall-to-roof joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_WAND_KELLER_ERL
data.value: The thermal bridge loss coefficient of the external wall-to-basement joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_ANS_FENSTER_ERL
data.value: The length of the window-to-wall joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_ANS_DACH_ERL
data.value: The length of the wall-to-roof joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_ANS_KELLER_ERL
data.value: The length of the external wall-to-basement joint.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_LUFTWECHSEL_ERL
data.value: The air change rate of the building; it determines the ventilation losses.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_RAHMENANTEIL_ERL
data.value: Share of the window frame in the window area (VDI 6007); empty = default value 0.3.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_VERSCHATTUNGSFAKTOR_ERL
data.value: Flat shading factor of the windows (VDI 6007); empty = default value 0.9.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_MASSEANTEIL_AUSSEN_ERL
data.value: Share of the thermal mass in the external components (VDI 6007); empty = default value 0.3.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_INNENFLAECHENFAKTOR_ERL
data.value: Internal component area per m² of usable area (VDI 6007); empty = default value 2.5.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_HEIZUNG_STRAHLUNGSANTEIL_ERL
data.value: Radiative fraction of the heat emission (VDI 6007); empty = default value 0.3.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_HEIZLEISTUNG_MAX_ERL
data.value: Maximum heating power of the hourly model in kW; empty = unlimited.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_AUSSENBAUTEILE_STRAHLUNG_ERL
data.value: Includes solar irradiation and long-wave emission on the opaque external components (VDI 6007).

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_LUFTWECHSEL_INFILTRATION_ERL
data.value: Air exchange through leakage (VDI 6007); if infiltration and occupant ventilation are empty, the air exchange rate applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_LUFTWECHSEL_NUTZER_ERL
data.value: Air exchange through window ventilation by occupants (VDI 6007); together with infiltration the air exchange of the hourly model.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_SOMMERLUEFTUNG_ERL
data.value: Increased air exchange on warm days when the outdoor air is cooler (VDI 6007).

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FENSTERFLAECHE_OST_ERL
data.value: Window area facing east in m²; empty = half of east + west.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FENSTERFLAECHE_WEST_ERL
data.value: Window area facing west in m²; empty = half of east + west.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_KELLERTEMPERATUR_ERL
data.value: Temperature of the unheated basement below the ground floor slab in °C; empty = default value 10 °C.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_RECHENWEG_ERL
data.value: The calculation method of the building: VDI 6007 (hourly model) or daily balance (legacy method); read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_BETRIEBSART_ERL
data.value: Edit, New or catalogue management; the operating mode decides which of the two saving paths is available.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_RANDBEDINGUNG_ERL
data.value: What the floor slab borders on: ground, basement (then with basement temperature) or outside air.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FERIEN_BEGINN_TAG_ERL
data.value: The day of the month on which the holiday period starts (1 to 31).

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FERIEN_BEGINN_MONAT_ERL
data.value: The month in which the holiday period starts (1 to 12).

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FERIEN_ENDE_TAG_ERL
data.value: The day of the month on which the holiday period ends (1 to 31); the winter holidays cross the turn of the year.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBK_FERIEN_ENDE_MONAT_ERL
data.value: The month in which the holiday period ends (1 to 12).

data.name: KI_DLG_MASKE_TPROF
data.value: Weekly hourly profile of a type

data.name: KI_DLG_MASKE_TSTAMM
data.value: Header record of a demand catalogue

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The display unit of the energy quantities; it affects key figures, monthly overview and chart alike.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_SORTIERT_ERL
data.value: Does the chart show the load duration curve instead of the annual load profile? Sorted means the 8,760 hourly values by magnitude.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_DIAGRAMM_ERL
data.value: Whom the heat load and room temperature charts show: the whole building or one of its zones; only for a building with several zones.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_GEBAEUDE_ERL
data.value: The name of the building whose heat demand the screen shows.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_HEIZWAERME_ERL
data.value: The annual sum of heating energy of this building. Domestic hot water and process heat are not included.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_MAX_LAST_ERL
data.value: The highest hourly load of the year; it determines the sizing of the generator.

data.name: KI_DLG_GEBB_VOLLBENUTZUNG_ERL
data.value: The full load hours: annual sum divided by peak load. Without a peak load there are none.

data.name: KI_DLG_GTYP_TYP_ERL
data.value: The loaded building type. Setting it loads its record together with its daily curves — the same path as a click in the list.

data.name: KI_DLG_GTYP_KURVE_ERL
data.value: The daily curve whose 24 hourly values the screen shows; a type carries five or eight of them.

data.name: KI_DLG_GTYP_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The free text of the loaded type; saved with “Save”. A delivered type is read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_GTYP_STUNDENWERTE_ERL
data.value: The 24 hourly values of the selected daily curve in the working state, hour 1 to 24 – the same that “Hourly values…” shows. “Save” writes them; while changed values are unsaved, the screen holds the curve change.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_BAUSTOFF_ERL
data.value: The selected building material of the list (its key is its id). Setting it selects the row – the same as a click; unsaved changes hold the selection.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The name of the building material; together with the manufacturer it is unique in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_GRUPPE_ERL
data.value: The group (e.g. masonry, concrete, insulation); empty = no group.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_HERSTELLER_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer; empty means manufacturer-neutral (standard or guide value).

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_LAMBDA_ERL
data.value: The thermal conductivity λ in W/(mK), permitted 0.005 to 500; empty = not specified (0 would be a different material).

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_RHO_ERL
data.value: The density ρ in kg/m³, permitted 5 to 8,000; empty = not specified.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_CP_ERL
data.value: The specific heat capacity c_p in J/(kgK) – not kJ –, permitted 100 to 5,000; empty = not specified.

data.name: KI_DLG_BST_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: Standard or data sheet the values come from.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_AUFBAU_ERL
data.value: The selected build-up of the list (its key is its id). Setting it selects the row with its layers – the same as a click.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The name of the build-up; unique in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_BAUTEILART_ERL
data.value: The component type the build-up is intended for; empty = any. The type sets the tilt and thus the surface resistances of the U-value; windows and curtain walls use their U-value and carry no layers.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: Standard or source of the build-up.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_BAUSTOFF_ERL
data.value: The building material of the layer (its key is its id; empty = free entry). Choosing it copies λ, ρ and c_p of the material; they can be overwritten afterwards.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_DICKE_ERL
data.value: The thickness of the layer in mm, permitted 1 to 1,000 (an unventilated air layer up to 300).

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_LAMBDA_ERL
data.value: The thermal conductivity λ of the layer in W/(mK); empty only for an unventilated air layer.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_RHO_ERL
data.value: The density ρ of the layer in kg/m³; a material layer needs it for the thermal mass.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_CP_ERL
data.value: The specific heat capacity c_p of the layer in J/(kgK); a material layer needs it for the thermal mass.

data.name: KI_DLG_BTA_SCHICHT_LUFTSCHICHT_ERL
data.value: The layer is an air layer. Without λ it is unventilated – its resistance follows DIN EN ISO 6946, Table 8.

data.name: KI_DLG_GTYP_OHNE_KURVE
data.value: The selected building type has no daily curve; select a type with curves first.

data.name: KI_DLG_TPROF_TYP_ERL
data.value: The loaded type. Setting it loads its weekly profile — the same path as a click in the list.

data.name: KI_DLG_TPROF_WOCHENTAG_ERL
data.value: The weekday whose 24 hourly values the screen shows; Monday is the first.

data.name: KI_DLG_TPROF_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The free text of the loaded type; it goes to the database when saving.

data.name: KI_DLG_TPROF_WOCHENWERTE_ERL
data.value: The 7 × 24 accepted hourly values of the week, Monday hour 1 to Sunday hour 24 – the state that “Save to DB” writes; the fields of the day shown follow.

data.name: KI_DLG_TSTAMM_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the catalogue record; the screen shows it locked. A different name is created with “Save as”.

data.name: KI_DLG_TSTAMM_TYP_ERL
data.value: The type from the type catalogue; it brings along the weekly hourly profile the monthly values are distributed by.

data.name: KI_DLG_TSTAMM_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: Free text for the catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_TSTAMM_MONATSWERTE_ERL
data.value: The twelve monthly values, January to December; each is mandatory before saving.

data.name: KI_DLG_BEDARFSART_ERL
data.value: Which of the three variants is open: process heat, electricity consumers or domestic hot water. The same screen serves all three.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The display unit; it applies to the information block, the totals and the input field beside it alike.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_NEUER_WERT_ERL
data.value: The new annual consumption of the marked assignment, in the unit beside it. It goes into the row with “Apply”.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_PROFIL_ERL
data.value: The name of the marked profile.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_TYP_ERL
data.value: The type of the marked profile; it brings along the hourly distribution the annual consumption is spread by.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The description of the marked profile from its header record.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_JAHRESVERBRAUCH_ERL
data.value: The annual consumption of the marked assignment as shown on the screen.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_SUMME_ERL
data.value: The total over all profiles assigned to this project.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_RECHENWEG_ERL
data.value: Where the domestic hot water channel of the simulation comes from: the existing profiles of this form or the project’s draw-off profile. Switching keeps the zones of the draw-off profile; “Draw-off profile” needs at least one zone.

data.name: KI_DLG_BPF_RECHENWEG_NUR_BW
data.value: The DHW calculation method is only available in the domestic hot water profiles of a saved project.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_NUR_MIT
data.value: “{0}” only appears with “{1}” — please select that first.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_ZEILE_FEHLT
data.value: This row is no longer in the list.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_STUFE_ERL
data.value: The depth of the dialog: “Basic” shows the zones, “Expert” also the stochastics of the annual series. The level only shows and hides fields, entered values are kept; “Extended” is locked in this version.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_ZONE_ERL
data.value: The selected zone of the zone list, by number or name; its input block is shown below the list. The values of every zone can also be set via the columns without selecting it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_ZONENNAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the zone; required for OK. It names the zone in the list, the preview and the messages.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_NUTZUNGSART_ERL
data.value: The type of use of the zone from the catalogue; it determines the reference quantity, the daily profile and the specific demand per level. Required for OK; a locked type of use names its reason.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_BEZUGSMENGE_ERL
data.value: The quantity of the zone in the reference quantity of its type of use (persons, dwellings, beds, area …); required for OK, greater than 0.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_NIVEAU_ERL
data.value: The demand level of the zone — low, medium or high; it selects the specific demand of the type of use per unit and day.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_JAHRESBEDARF_ERL
data.value: The annual draw-off demand of the zone from the current preview; “–” without a calculated preview. Read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_ANSICHT_ERL
data.value: Which view the preview shows its charts and key figures for: the sum of all zones or one zone. Only changes the display.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_RECHENWEG_ERL
data.value: Which annual series enters the balance: the deterministic one or the stochastically drawn year for the seed, scaled to the annual amount. Appears from level “Expert”; the preview stays deterministic.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_SEED_ERL
data.value: The random seed, whole number from 0; empty = default. The same seed draws the same series — for the annual series and the design ensemble. Appears in level “Expert”.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPG_REALISIERUNGEN_ERL
data.value: How many years the stochastic run draws to check consistency; empty = default. Appears in level “Expert” with the “stochastic” method.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_BEDARFSTAG_ERL
data.value: The design day of the cumulative curve: default rule, hourly profile of the zones, DIN 4708 profile, a constructed day or a day from the catalogue. Locked sources name their reason; a day is constructed with the button below.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_SPEICHERTEMPERATUR_ERL
data.value: The storage temperature; empty = default of the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_ERZEUGERLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The generator output at the storage, not negative; empty = assumed charging output. The verification output is the smaller of generator and heat exchanger.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_UEBERTRAGERLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The heat exchanger output, not negative; empty = from U·A, area or the estimate for the generator type.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_SPEICHERART_ERL
data.value: Charging storage or mixed storage — it determines the cumulative curve.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_SENSORHOEHE_ERL
data.value: The height of the temperature sensor as a share of the storage height, from 0 to 1; empty = default of the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_ERZEUGERART_ERL
data.value: The generator type at the storage (boiler or heat pump) — a run setting for estimating the heat exchanger; it is not saved.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_WERKSTOFF_ERL
data.value: The heat exchanger material (steel or stainless steel) — a run setting; it is not saved.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_STOCHASTISCH_ERL
data.value: Draws the ensemble of the design day per topology group for percentile, spread and simultaneity; the run calculates in the background. A run setting; it is not saved.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_PERZENTIL_ERL
data.value: The design percentile, P95 or P99. Appears only with “Calculate stochastically”.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_REALISIERUNGEN_ERL
data.value: How many design days the ensemble draws; empty = default of the core. Below the minimum number the percentile is not reliable. Appears only with “Calculate stochastically”.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGA_PUNKT_ERL
data.value: The recommended design point — for storage volume and output, otherwise the minute peak; OK takes it over into the draw-off profile. Result, read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the constructed design day; required, not yet used in the catalogue version.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_BEGINN_ERL
data.value: The start of the row’s time window in hours, from 0 to 24.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_ENDE_ERL
data.value: The end of the row’s time window in hours, up to 24 and after the start.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_REGEL_ERL
data.value: A draw-off rule from the catalogue — then the number of its draw-offs counts — or “Volume directly” with volume and draw-off temperature.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_ANZAHL_ERL
data.value: How often the draw-off rule draws within the time window, not negative; only with a draw-off rule.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_VOLUMEN_ERL
data.value: The volume of the row in litres, not negative; only with “Volume directly”.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_TEMPERATUR_ERL
data.value: The draw-off temperature of the volume; only with “Volume directly”.

data.name: KI_DLG_ZPGK_VERBRAUCHER_ERL
data.value: A neutral name of the draw-off point (“Kitchen”); it names the row and does not enter the calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_BADM_SATZ_ERL
data.value: The marked catalogue record. Setting it selects it in the list and the record sheet follows; with unsaved changes, save or discard first.

data.name: KI_DLG_BADM_TYP_ERL
data.value: The type of the marked record, chosen from the type list; it determines the weekly profile.

data.name: KI_DLG_BADM_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The description of the marked record as free text.

data.name: KI_DLG_BADM_JAHRESSUMME_ERL
data.value: The annual total of the marked record as shown on the screen.

data.name: KI_DLG_BERG_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The display unit of the energy quantities; it affects all three tab sheets alike.

data.name: KI_DLG_BERG_TABELLE_ERL
data.value: Which view the key figure and monthly table shows; it changes independently of the chart.

data.name: KI_DLG_BERG_GRAFIK_ERL
data.value: Which view the chart shows; a change away from domestic hot water takes the annual profile along.

data.name: KI_DLG_BERG_JAHRESVERLAUF_ERL
data.value: Does the chart show the annual profile? The switch exists only for the domestic hot water view and only when an annual profile is available.

data.name: KI_DLG_WBX_KANAL_ERL
data.value: Which demand the profile feeds: heating, domestic hot water or process heat. The channel applies per assignment, not per profile.

data.name: KI_DLG_WBX_GANGLINIE_ERL
data.value: The name of the assigned profile.

data.name: KI_DLG_SGL_KATALOG_ERL
data.value: The solar profile marked in the catalogue; it is the one that “Add to project” takes over.

data.name: KI_DLG_SGL_PROJEKT_ERL
data.value: The solar profile marked in the project list; it is the one that “Remove from project” takes out.

data.name: KI_DLG_SGL_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: The description of the marked profile from its catalogue record.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the climate data come from: from the PVGIS service, from a single TRY file or from a TRY package. The source decides which fields appear below.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_ORT_ERL
data.value: The place name the coordinates are looked up for. It may also be entered freely.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_LAENGE_ERL
data.value: The longitude of the site, in decimal degrees. East of Greenwich it is positive.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_BREITE_ERL
data.value: The latitude of the site, in decimal degrees. North of the equator it is positive.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_BEZEICHNUNG_ERL
data.value: The name the climate region is stored under. When reading a TRY file it is pre-filled from the file name.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_JAHR_ERL
data.value: The reference year of the test reference year; the current state and the projection are available.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_SZENARIO_ERL
data.value: The scenario of the test reference year: average year, warm summer or cold winter.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_TRY_DATEI_ERL
data.value: The selected TRY file. A path is not typed, it is chosen through the file dialogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_KLIMA_TRY_PAKET_ERL
data.value: The selected TRY package. It may stay empty; then the supplied package is used.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier selected in the list. Everything on the carrier card belongs to it; setting it loads its prices, units and emissions.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_SUCHE_ERL
data.value: Filter text above the carrier list. It hides carriers whose name or group does not contain it; the selection is kept.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STAMMNAME_ERL
data.value: Name of the catalog record. Available only in catalog management; it is written by Save or OK.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STAMMGRUPPE_ERL
data.value: The group the carrier is listed under. It only orders the display and does not enter the calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_ARBEITSPREIS_ERL
data.value: The consumption-dependent price of the carrier, relative to the price basis below. Together with the calorific value it yields the price per kilowatt hour used in the economic calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_GRUNDPREIS_ERL
data.value: The consumption-independent annual amount of the supply contract — meter rent, provision, billing.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_LEISTUNGSPREIS_ERL
data.value: The price per kilowatt of connected load. Whether it applies per year or per month is stated by the adjacent switch.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_LPMODUS_ERL
data.value: Does the demand charge apply per month instead of per year? Monthly mode uses each month's peak load, annual mode the annual peak.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_HEIZWERT_ERL
data.value: Calorific value of the fuel. It converts the billing unit into kilowatt hours; without it no price per kilowatt hour can be formed.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BRENNWERT_ERL
data.value: Gross calorific value of the fuel. Needed for condensing appliances; shown only on carriers that carry it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_PREISBASIS_ERL
data.value: The unit in which the energy price is entered: the quantity unit of the carrier (such as litre, cubic metre or kilogram) or the kilowatt hour once a net calorific value is maintained. The price is always stored per quantity unit; switching only converts the display via the net calorific value.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BASISEINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit the price chain calculates in — display only. It follows the price basis and the active conversion rules.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_EFFEKTIV_ERL
data.value: The calculated price per kilowatt hour with its derivation — display only. It follows energy price, calorific value, price basis and the conversion rules.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_GUELTIGAB_ERL
data.value: The price date from which the card's values apply (YYYY-MM-DD). On saving, the previous state moves into the price history.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_CO2E_ERL
data.value: Does the mask calculate in CO₂ equivalent (GWP₁₀₀) instead of pure CO₂? In catalog management the choice is locked — the project's setting applies there.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_CO2_ERL
data.value: The carrier's substitute CO₂ value as long as the emission catalog holds none for it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_SO2_ERL
data.value: The carrier's substitute SO₂ value as long as the emission catalog holds none for it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_NOX_ERL
data.value: The carrier's substitute NOx value as long as the emission catalog holds none for it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_ANTEIL_AKTIV_ERL
data.value: Is this component maintained? Switched off means "no component", not "zero" — the amount next to it then has no effect and does not enter the total.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_BESCHAFFUNG_ERL
data.value: The procurement share of the electricity price — what the supplier pays for the energy itself.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_VERTRIEB_ERL
data.value: The sales share of the electricity price — the supplier's margin, billing and customer service.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_NETZ_ERL
data.value: The energy-related share of the grid fee. The demand-related share is in the carrier card's demand charge.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_STEUER_ERL
data.value: The electricity tax per kilowatt hour. The standard and reduced rates are offered as quick choices next to it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_KONZESSION_ERL
data.value: The municipal concession levy per kilowatt hour.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_UMLAGEN_ERL
data.value: The statutory levies as ONE total. It applies as long as the switch "itemise levies" is off.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_EINZELN_ERL
data.value: Are the levies itemised instead of totalled? When on, the CHP, offshore and section 19 StromNEV levies replace the summary line.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_KWKG_ERL
data.value: The CHP levy per kilowatt hour — visible only when the levies are itemised.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_OFFSHORE_ERL
data.value: The offshore grid levy per kilowatt hour — visible only when the levies are itemised.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_STROM_NEV_ERL
data.value: The levy under section 19 StromNEV per kilowatt hour — visible only when the levies are itemised.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BS_ENERGIESTEUER_ERL
data.value: The energy tax within the fuel's energy price. The block breaks the price down; it does not change it.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BS_CO2_ERL
data.value: The CO₂ component under the German fuel emissions trading act within the fuel's energy price.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BS_NETZ_ERL
data.value: The grid and metering fee within the fuel's energy price.

data.name: KI_DLG_ET_BS_VERTRIEB_ERL
data.value: Procurement and sales within the fuel's energy price — what remains after tax, CO₂ and grid fee.

data.name: KI_DLG_ETV_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier the new variant derives from. Setting it pre-fills the variant name.

data.name: KI_DLG_ETV_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the new variant. It must not be empty, otherwise the dialog stays open on OK.

data.name: KI_DLG_LPR_JAHR_ERL
data.value: The year the twelve monthly rates apply to. There is exactly one series per carrier and year.

data.name: KI_DLG_LPR_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit of the twelve monthly rates — display only. It follows the carrier's demand charge mode.

data.name: KI_DLG_LPR_KONTEXT_ERL
data.value: Which energy carrier the series belongs to — display only.

data.name: KI_DLG_LPR_MONATSSAETZE_ERL
data.value: The twelve capacity price rates of the year, January to December; “Apply” writes the series.

data.name: KI_DLG_KPR_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The name of the cost profile. It appears under this name in the catalog and on the carrier card.

data.name: KI_DLG_KPR_WOCHENTAG_ERL
data.value: The weekday whose 24 hourly values the "week" tab shows. Changing it shows a different daily curve; the values themselves are in the number series "Deviation per weekday and hour".

data.name: KI_DLG_KPR_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit the monthly and weekly values are given in — display only.

data.name: KI_DLG_KPR_MONATSWERTE_ERL
data.value: The twelve monthly levels of the profile, January to December; the hourly deviations are added to them.

data.name: KI_DLG_KPR_WOCHENWERTE_ERL
data.value: The 7 × 24 deviations, Monday hour 1 to Sunday hour 24; they are added to the monthly level and may be negative.

data.name: KI_DLG_KV_VARIANTE_ERL
data.value: The template variant whose positions the table shows — master context only. Switching it loads a different set of positions and is therefore not a field value; the assistant names it and the alternatives but cannot set it here.

data.name: KI_DLG_KFK_FAKTOR_ERL
data.value: The cost factor selected in the grid. Setting it selects it — only then does Delete apply.

data.name: KI_DLG_KFK_NEU_ERL
data.value: The name under which "New" creates a cost factor. An empty name creates nothing.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_MODUS_ERL
data.value: Does the mask calculate in CO₂ equivalent (GWP₁₀₀) instead of pure CO₂? The choice governs both grids and the total below them.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_ART_ERL
data.value: The emission type selected in the upper grid. It determines which values appear below and what Edit and Delete apply to.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_WERT_ERL
data.value: The value of the selected type that is marked in the lower grid. It is the one that "Apply" hands to the energy carrier.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_KUERZEL_ERL
data.value: The abbreviation of the edited type (CO2, CH4, N2O). It cannot be changed on a type that ships with the program.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The plain-text name of the edited type as it appears in both grids.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit of the edited type — grams or milligrams per kilowatt hour. It applies to all values of this type.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_GWP_ERL
data.value: The factor by which the type is converted into CO₂ equivalent. It is locked on a mandatory type.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_ARTQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the global warming potential comes from (IPCC report, standard, own decision).

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_WERTQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the edited emission value comes from (GEMIS, data sheet, own measurement).

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_WERTZAHL_ERL
data.value: The numeric value itself, in the unit of its type.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_WERTCO2E_ERL
data.value: Is the value already given as CO₂ equivalent? Then it is not multiplied by the global warming potential a second time.

data.name: KI_DLG_EMK_VORLAGE_ERL
data.value: Should the new value also serve as a suggestion for other energy carriers? The switch appears only when creating a value in a carrier context.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_SUCHE_ERL
data.value: Filter text above the table. It hides records whose technology or position type does not contain it.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_TECHNIK_ERL
data.value: The technology under which "New" creates the record. Empty means "across technologies" — the record then applies to all trades.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_ART_NAME
data.value: Position type of the new entry

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_ART_ERL
data.value: The position type under which "New" creates the record — the name a cost position later finds it by.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUWERT_NAME
data.value: Service life of the new entry

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUWERT_ERL
data.value: The calculated service life of the new record under VDI 2067.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUAFA_NAME
data.value: Depreciation period of the new entry

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUAFA_ERL
data.value: The tax depreciation period of the new record. It may differ from the calculated service life.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_WERT_ERL
data.value: The calculated service life of this record under VDI 2067. It determines how often a position is replaced within the study period.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_AFA_ERL
data.value: The tax depreciation period of this record. It may differ from the calculated service life.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the period comes from (VDI 2067, depreciation table, manufacturer data, own decision).

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUINST_NAME
data.value: Repair rate of the new entry

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUINST_ERL
data.value: The repair rate of the new record as a percentage of the investment per year under VDI 2067 Part 1, Table A2; empty means “no rate”.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUWART_NAME
data.value: Maintenance rate of the new entry

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_NEUWART_ERL
data.value: The maintenance rate of the new record as a percentage of the investment per year under VDI 2067 Part 1, Table A2; empty means “no rate”.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_INST_ERL
data.value: The repair rate of this record as a percentage of the investment per year under VDI 2067 Part 1, Table A2. “Preset rates…” in cost management enters it into an operating cost item “Instandhaltung …” measured as “% of investment”, as does adopting a cost template.

data.name: KI_DLG_NUD_WART_ERL
data.value: The maintenance rate of this record as a percentage of the investment per year under VDI 2067 Part 1, Table A2. “Preset rates…” in cost management enters it into an operating cost item “Wartung …” measured as “% of investment”, as does adopting a cost template.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_BEZ_ERL
data.value: The name of the cost position as it appears in the template and in the report.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_KOSTENART_ERL
data.value: The cost category under VDI 2067 — capital, demand, operation or other. It determines the category the position appears under in the evaluation.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_ERLOES_ERL
data.value: Is the position a revenue rather than a cost? A revenue enters the net present value with the opposite sign.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_POSART_ERL
data.value: The position type the service life comes from. Without it the position uses the service life of its component.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_VON_ERL
data.value: The lower bound of the recommended rate. It is a hint at the input field, not a restriction.

data.name: KI_DLG_VOP_BIS_ERL
data.value: The upper bound of the recommended rate. It is a hint at the input field, not a restriction.

data.name: KI_DLG_MASKE_CSE
data.value: Worst and best case of a position

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_MODUS_ERL
data.value: Do the two cost fields hold a percentage DEVIATION from the expected value instead of an amount in euros? Without a maintained expected value the percentage mode is locked.

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_BEST_ERL
data.value: The cost of the position in the most favourable case — an amount or a deviation depending on the input mode. An amount is always what gets stored.

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_WORST_ERL
data.value: The cost of the position in the least favourable case — an amount or a deviation depending on the input mode. An amount is always what gets stored.

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_BESTDAUER_NAME
data.value: Service life in the best case

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_BESTDAUER_ERL
data.value: The service life of the position in the most favourable case. It governs how often it is replaced within the study period.

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_WORSTDAUER_NAME
data.value: Service life in the worst case

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_WORSTDAUER_ERL
data.value: The service life of the position in the least favourable case. It governs how often it is replaced within the study period.

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_JAHR_ERL
data.value: The year of the study period in which the payment begins; 0 means "in the first year".

data.name: KI_DLG_CSE_ZUSCHUSS_ERL
data.value: Is the position a subsidy rather than an expense? The switch appears only where a subsidy is possible at all.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_ZINS_ERL
data.value: The discount rate i of the present value calculation under VDI 2067. It determines how strongly later payments are discounted against present ones.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_JAHRE_ERL
data.value: The study period T in years. The present value calculation runs over it; replacements and residual values follow from it.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_PREIS_E_ERL
data.value: The annual price increase of energy costs p_E. It indexes fuel and electricity prices over the study period.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_PREIS_B_ERL
data.value: The annual price increase of operating costs p_B — maintenance, servicing, operation.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_PREIS_I_ERL
data.value: The annual price increase of the investment p_I. Empty means "as operation", not "0 %/a"; the rate indexes replacements and the price basis of the residual value.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_EINSP_ERL
data.value: The feed-in tariff for PV electricity. It applies throughout the application: it values exported electricity AND provides the selling price used by the storage model.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_CO2_ERL
data.value: The constant CO₂ price; 0 means "path from the statutory catalog", not "no price".

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_PARK_ERL
data.value: The reference power plant mix the electricity credit is calculated against.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BILANZJAHR_ERL
data.value: The balance year of the emission calculation; 0 means "not maintained".

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_METHODE_ERL
data.value: How the emissions of CHP electricity are accounted — from the catalog, with electricity credit, without credit, or by substitution.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_BIOMASSE_ERL
data.value: How the combustion of biomass is accounted — zero approach or actual combustion emissions.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_NACHWEIS_ERL
data.value: Is a sustainability certificate available for the biomass used? Without it the zero approach does not apply.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_ZINS_ERL
data.value: The discount rate in this scenario. The field shows the EFFECTIVE rate — the default is one percentage point away from the expected value; typing maintains an own value.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_PREIS_E_ERL
data.value: The energy cost price increase in this scenario — effective value, default one percentage point away from the expected value.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_PREIS_B_ERL
data.value: The operating cost price increase in this scenario — effective value, default one percentage point away from the expected value.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_PREIS_I_ERL
data.value: The investment price increase in this scenario — effective value, default one percentage point away from the effective expected rate.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_INVEST_ERL
data.value: The change in investment in this scenario. It applies ONLY to positions without their own scenario value.
