data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_ERTRAG_ERL
data.value: The change in revenues in this scenario. It applies to feed-in revenue and PV remuneration, not to the statutory revenue series.

data.name: KI_DLG_WPA_SZ_DAUER_ERL
data.value: The change in service lives in this scenario, in years. It governs how often replacement occurs within the study period.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_MODUL_ERL
data.value: The CHP unit whose data appear below. All fields prefixed "unit" belong to it; the fields prefixed "project" apply to all units.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_STICHTAG_A_ERL
data.value: The order or approval date of this unit. It determines eligibility under the German CHP act.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_IBN_A_ERL
data.value: The commissioning of this unit. Support duration and the full-load hours schedule start from it.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_ART_ERL
data.value: The unit category under the CHP act. It determines the bonus schedule and whether tendering is required.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_FALL_ERL
data.value: The self-supply case under section 6(3) of the CHP act — it determines whether self-consumed electricity receives a bonus at all.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_SATZ_EINSP_ERL
data.value: The CHP bonus on exported electricity of this unit; 0 means "no own rate" — the statutory schedule then applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_SATZ_EIGEN_ERL
data.value: The CHP bonus on self-consumed electricity of this unit; 0 means "no own rate".

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_KONTINGENT_ERL
data.value: The full-load hours quota of this unit; 0 means "derived under section 8".

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_DECKEL_ERL
data.value: The annual full-load hours cap; 0 means "degressive schedule from the commissioning year".

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_KOSTENANTEIL_ERL
data.value: This unit's share of the total investment. It is needed for the tier selection under section 8.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_ES_A_ERL
data.value: The energy tax option of THIS unit. It takes precedence over the project default below.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_AUF_A_ERL
data.value: The fuel allocation method for THIS unit — it determines which share is attributed to electricity and which to heat.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_HILFS_ERL
data.value: The auxiliary energy share of the unit. 0 is a valid value and means "no auxiliary energy".

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_EINSP_KWK_ERL
data.value: The feed-in tariff for CHP electricity; 0 means "not maintained" — the PV rate from the economic parameters then applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_ABSCHLAG_ERL
data.value: The deduction for negative spot prices — the share of hours for which no bonus is paid.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_PAUSCHAL_ERL
data.value: The lump-sum payment under section 9 of the CHP act. It applies only up to 2 kW electrical output and is paid once.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_STICHTAG_P_ERL
data.value: The project-wide CHP act reference date. It applies to units without their own date.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_IBN_P_ERL
data.value: The support start — the first year of the project's CHP act series.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_ES_P_ERL
data.value: The energy tax option of the PROJECT. It applies to units without their own option.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_AUF_P_ERL
data.value: The allocation method of the PROJECT. It applies to units without their own method.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_NUTZUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The annual utilisation rate of the CHP plant; 0 means "not recorded". It is needed only for section 53a of the energy tax act (70 % threshold).

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_UA_ERL
data.value: The type of undertaking under the electricity tax act. It determines which exemptions apply.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_RAEUMLICH_ERL
data.value: Is the spatial connection of 4.5 km between generation and consumption given? Without it the electricity tax exemption does not apply.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_HOCHEFFIZIENZ_ERL
data.value: Is a high-efficiency certificate available? It is a prerequisite for some of the exemptions.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_MODUS_ERL
data.value: The mode of section 9(1) no. 3 of the electricity tax act — it determines which exemption is applied.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_ABWAERME_ERL
data.value: Does the plant have a device for waste-heat dissipation (section 2 no. 16 of the CHP act, second case)? Then its CHP electricity is not the net generation but min(net generation ; useful heat × power-to-heat ratio) — it only determines the quantity paid; the full-load hours of the quota count as without the device, from the generated energy (gross ÷ rated electrical output).

data.name: KI_DLG_BHW_SIGMA_ERL
data.value: The power-to-heat ratio σ of the plant for the second case of section 2 no. 16 of the CHP act. Empty means σ is formed from P_el ÷ P_th of the unit row; an own value applies permanently. σ is only read if the plant has a device for waste-heat dissipation.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_AKTIV_ERL
data.value: Is the tariff structure applied at all? When off, the simulation uses the plain energy price of the carrier.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_GUELTIGAB_ERL
data.value: The price date from which the tariff structure applies (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD).

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_WINTERVON_ERL
data.value: The month the winter period begins with — it separates the summer and winter maximum of the demand charge model “Scale”.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_WINTERBIS_ERL
data.value: The month the winter period ends with.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_BEZUG_ARBEIT_ERL
data.value: The energy price of the supply role in the role model.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_BEZUG_GRUND_ERL
data.value: The base price of the supply role in the role model.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_REST_ARBEIT_ERL
data.value: The energy price of the residual supply role — the electricity the project must buy despite its own generation.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_REST_GRUND_ERL
data.value: The base price of the residual supply role.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_LM_ERL
data.value: The demand price model of this role — monthly, tiered or by annual peak load.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_MONAT_ERL
data.value: The monthly price of this role — it applies only in the monthly demand price model.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_EINSP_ARBEIT_ERL
data.value: The export price of the export role in the role model.

data.name: KI_DLG_TAR_EINSP_GRUND_ERL
data.value: The base price of the export role in the role model.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_AKTIV_ERL
data.value: Is the remuneration calculation applied at all? When off, the economic calculation values exported electricity with the rate from the economic parameters.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_LEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The specified plant capacity; 0 means "none" — the calculated capacity from the project's plants then applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_IBN_ERL
data.value: The commissioning of the plant (ISO). It determines the applicable value and is mandatory when the calculation applies.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_DEGRADATION_ERL
data.value: The annual performance decline of the modules; 0 means "none".

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_EINSPEISEART_ERL
data.value: Surplus or full export. It determines the applicable value and whether self-consumption is calculated at all.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_AW_ERL
data.value: The specified applicable value; 0 means "rate from the statutory catalog".

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_VERMARKTUNG_ERL
data.value: The marketing form — feed-in tariff, market premium, other direct marketing, or none.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_DV_ERL
data.value: The direct marketing fee. It applies only with the market premium.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_PPA_ERL
data.value: The agreed PPA price; 0 means "none". It applies only with other direct marketing.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_PPA_AUFSCHLAG_ERL
data.value: The premium or discount on the spot price in the PPA. It applies only with other direct marketing.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_PAR51_ERL
data.value: Does section 51 of the renewable energy act apply (no revenue at negative prices)? Automatic means "decide from commissioning and capacity".

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_IMSYS_ERL
data.value: The installation year of the smart metering system; 0 means "none". It exempts the plant from part of the curtailment.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_AUSFALL_ERL
data.value: The assumed share of revenue lost to negative prices.

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_PAR51A_ERL
data.value: Is the loss under section 51a of the renewable energy act compensated by extending the support period?

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_BEZUG_ERL
data.value: Is self-consumption valued from the electricity carrier's price series instead of the fixed energy price?

data.name: KI_DLG_PVV_KAPPUNG_ERL
data.value: Does the 60 percent export curtailment apply? Automatic means "decide from commissioning and metering system".

data.name: KI_DLG_GSK_KLASSE_ERL
data.value: The class whose annual entries the list shows — CO₂ price path, CHP rates, energy and electricity tax, and the catalog's remaining categories.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSK_ZEILE_ERL
data.value: The annual entry selected in the list. It determines what Edit and Delete apply to.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_SCHLUESSEL_ERL
data.value: The key of the entry — the language-neutral name the calculation finds the rate by. It is locked when editing.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_KLASSE_ERL
data.value: The class the entry belongs to. It is locked when editing — an entry does not change its category.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_JAHR_ERL
data.value: The year from which the value applies. It applies until the next entry with the same key.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_WERT_ERL
data.value: The value itself. An empty field means "the rate ceased from this year on", not "zero".

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit of the value. It belongs to the entry, not to the class.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_STATUS_ERL
data.value: The status of the entry — enacted, forecast or ceased. It states how reliable the value is.

data.name: KI_DLG_GSZ_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: The source the value comes from — law, ordinance or publication with its date.

data.name: KI_DLG_KSE_ANLAGE_ERL
data.value: The plant selected in the cost table. It determines which component the cost management opens and highlights its energy carrier row.

data.name: KI_DLG_KSE_PROJEKT_ERL
data.value: The project whose costs the page shows — display only. The comparison above it, in contrast, covers the whole comparison group.

data.name: KI_DLG_KSE_STATUS_ERL
data.value: The footer with the page's findings — missing positions, unassigned entries, notes on the comparison group.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_SZENARIO_ERL
data.value: The scenario the key figures are calculated under — expected, best or worst case. The rates behind it are in the economic parameters dialog.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_SICHT_ERL
data.value: All selected states against the group's reference — or exactly two states A and B. The second view is available only when the group holds more than one state.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_REFERENZ_ERL
data.value: The group's reference — the do-nothing alternative under DIN EN 17463 all other states are calculated against. It may also be a variant.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_A_ERL
data.value: State A of the pair view; it acts as the reference there. The list does not contain B — so A and B differ without any message.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_B_ERL
data.value: State B of the pair view. The list does not contain A — so A and B differ without any message.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_WIRKUNG_ERL
data.value: The description of a non-monetisable effect under DIN EN 17463 — security of supply, comfort, emissions, operating effort. It is saved on request (“Save”), not on every keystroke; the report shows it unchanged.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_ZR_STAND_ERL
data.value: The version whose cash flow series block 2 of the ValERI assessment shows — by default the lead version. The choice only changes the display of the annual table and the cash flow chart, not the key figures; only versions for which the last calculation run delivered annual series can be chosen.

data.name: KI_DLG_WSE_ZR_SZENARIO_ERL
data.value: The scenario whose cash flow series block 2 of the ValERI assessment shows — by default the expected case. The choice only changes the display; if the version does not carry the scenario, the expected case is shown. The scenario of the key figures is set by the field “Scenario”.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The module name of the catalogue record; it is the key the record is saved under and therefore read-only in edit mode.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the module; it serves recognition in the catalogue and enters no calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_MOTORTYP_ERL
data.value: The engine type as free text, for example gas Otto or pilot injection.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: A multi-line note on the module; it only appears in the catalogue and affects no calculation.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_PTHERM_ERL
data.value: The rated thermal output of the module at full load.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_PEL_ERL
data.value: The rated electrical output of the module at full load; it is the reference for profitability and the electricity credit.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_WG_EL_ERL
data.value: The electrical efficiency as a factor, for example 0.30 for thirty percent.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_WG_TH_ERL
data.value: The thermal efficiency as a factor, for example 0.60 for sixty percent.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_WG_GESAMT_ERL
data.value: The overall efficiency is the sum of the two shares and follows every entry; what you change are the shares.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_GRENZLEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The lower limit output as a share of the rated output; below it the module shuts down instead of modulating further.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_TRAEGER_ERL
data.value: The energy carrier the module runs on; it determines the fuel price and the emission factor.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_VORLAUF_ERL
data.value: The flow temperature at which the module feeds into the network.

data.name: KI_DLG_BHKK_RUECKLAUF_ERL
data.value: The return temperature at which the module is fed.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_NAME_ERL
data.value: The collector name of the catalogue record; it is the key of the record and therefore read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the collector; it serves recognition in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: A multi-line note on the collector; it only appears in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_TYP_ERL
data.value: The collector type as free text, for example flat plate or evacuated tube.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_MODULFLAECHE_ERL
data.value: The gross area of one module including the frame; it determines the space required, not the yield.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_APERTURFLAECHE_ERL
data.value: The effective aperture area of one module; the conversion factor and the loss coefficients refer to it.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_H0_ERL
data.value: The conversion factor h0: the share of irradiation the collector converts at zero temperature difference.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_K1_ERL
data.value: The linear heat loss coefficient k1 of the collector curve.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_K2_ERL
data.value: The quadratic heat loss coefficient k2 of the collector curve.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_KDIR_ERL
data.value: The incidence angle modifier Kdir for direct irradiation.

data.name: KI_DLG_SKK_KDIFF_ERL
data.value: The incidence angle modifier Kdiff for diffuse irradiation, given at fifty degrees.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The identifier of the storage record; it is the key the record is written under and therefore read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_PV_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The identifier of the module record; it is the key the record is written under and therefore read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer; the catalogue list can be narrowed down by it.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: A multi-line note on the record; it only appears in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_TYP_ERL
data.value: The storage type as free text, for example lithium-ion; it describes the cell chemistry.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_ENERGIE_ERL
data.value: The rated capacity of one storage module.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_LEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The charge and discharge power of one storage module.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_LADEZUSTAND_ERL
data.value: The usable share of the capacity; it limits the depth of discharge.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_DEGRADATION_ERL
data.value: The annual capacity loss of the storage unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_KOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related module cost of the storage unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_WG_RT_ERL
data.value: The round-trip efficiency over charging and discharging as a factor; empty means not maintained.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_ZYKLEN_ERL
data.value: The cycle life of the storage unit; empty means not maintained.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_VERSCHLEISS_ERL
data.value: The wear cost per kilowatt hour throughput; empty means not maintained.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_LEISTUNGSKOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The power-related share of the investment; empty means not maintained.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_INVEST_FIX_ERL
data.value: The fixed share of the investment per storage unit, independent of size and power.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_STANDBY_ERL
data.value: The standby power of the storage unit at rest.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_PMAX_ERL
data.value: The rated power of one module under standard test conditions; it is the only mandatory field of the module catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_WIRKUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The module efficiency under standard test conditions.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_UMPP_ERL
data.value: The voltage at the maximum power point; it enters the string layout.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_ULEERLAUF_ERL
data.value: The open-circuit voltage; it limits the number of modules in series.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_IMPP_ERL
data.value: The current at the maximum power point.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_IKURZSCHLUSS_ERL
data.value: The short-circuit current; it limits the number of parallel strings per input.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_TEMPKOEFF_ERL
data.value: The temperature coefficient of power; it is negative and states how much power is lost per kelvin of cell heating.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_LAENGE_ERL
data.value: The length of the module; length and width give the area the layout needs.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_PV_KOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The price of one module; the plant cost follows from it via the module count.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_TNOCT_ERL
data.value: The cell temperature under nominal operating conditions; it drives the heating in the yield model.

data.name: KI_DLG_MODK_TECHNOLOGIE_ERL
data.value: The cell technology of the module; it selects the curve shape in the extended yield model.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_BEZEICHNER_ERL
data.value: The identifier of the device record; it is the key the record is written under and therefore read-only.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_FIRMA_ERL
data.value: The manufacturer of the device; the catalogue list can be narrowed down by it.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_BESCHREIBUNG_ERL
data.value: A multi-line note on the device; it only appears in the catalogue.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_P_AC_NENN_ERL
data.value: The rated active power on the AC side; it is the only mandatory field of the device.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_S_AC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The maximum apparent power on the AC side.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_P_DC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The maximum generator power the inverter accepts on the DC side.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_KOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The price of one device; it enters the investment of the plant.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_HERKUNFT_ERL
data.value: Where the record comes from: the device import sets the source, a hand-maintained record carries „HAND“. The entry is information, not input.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_U_MPP_MIN_ERL
data.value: The lower voltage of the MPP range; below it the device no longer tracks.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_U_MPP_MAX_ERL
data.value: The upper voltage of the MPP range.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_U_DC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The maximum permissible DC voltage at the input; it must not be exceeded even at cold open circuit.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_U_START_ERL
data.value: The voltage from which the device starts operating.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_I_DC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The maximum operating current per MPP tracker.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_I_SC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The maximum permissible short-circuit current per MPP tracker; beyond it the device is damaged.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ANZAHL_MPPT_ERL
data.value: The number of independent MPP trackers of the device.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_STRAENGE_JE_MPPT_ERL
data.value: The number of strings that can be connected to one MPP tracker.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA05_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at five percent partial load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA10_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at ten percent partial load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA20_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at twenty percent partial load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA30_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at thirty percent partial load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA50_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at fifty percent partial load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA100_ERL
data.value: The efficiency at full load, as a factor from zero to one.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA_EURO_ERL
data.value: The European efficiency: the weighted mean of the partial load values.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_ETA_MAX_ERL
data.value: The highest efficiency the device reaches.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_P_STANDBY_ERL
data.value: The standby power of the device during the day.

data.name: KI_DLG_WRK_P_NACHT_ERL
data.value: The loss power of the device at night.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_QUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the load profile comes from: an existing profile or an imported file.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_GANGLINIE_ERL
data.value: The selected catalogue load profile; it is loaded immediately when changed.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_P_ERL
data.value: The maximum charging and discharging power of the storage unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_KAPAZITAET_ERL
data.value: The usable storage capacity; together with the SoC band it gives the working range.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_ETA_ERL
data.value: The round-trip efficiency; it is split evenly between charging and discharging.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_SOCMIN_ERL
data.value: The lower limit of the state of charge; the unit does not discharge below it.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_SOCMAX_ERL
data.value: The upper limit of the state of charge; the unit does not charge above it.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_STARTSOC_ERL
data.value: The state of charge at the start of the run.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_ADAPTIV_ERL
data.value: Raises the threshold during the run when the unit cannot hold a peak; otherwise it stays fixed.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_ZIEL_ERL
data.value: The fixed target threshold of the grid draw; it applies only without adaptive tracking.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_LP_ERL
data.value: The demand charge of the grid connection; it values the peak that was cut.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_BEZUGSPREIS_ERL
data.value: The average energy price of the grid draw; it values the conversion losses.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_KOMPAT_ERL
data.value: Calculates without losses and without a lower SoC limit — the predecessor's mode.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_CCAP_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related share of the investment.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_CPOW_ERL
data.value: The power-related share of the investment.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_IFIX_ERL
data.value: The fixed share of the investment, independent of size and power.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_ZINS_ERL
data.value: The discount rate of the annuity.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_NUTZUNGSDAUER_ERL
data.value: The service life of the storage unit; it determines the annuity factor.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_SOC_ERL
data.value: Shows the state-of-charge curve on the second axis of the chart.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_REITER_ERL
data.value: Which sheet is open: key figures, chart or monthly values.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_REIHE_ERL
data.value: The loaded series with its number of values and its maximum.

data.name: KI_DLG_PEAK_HERKUNFT_ERL
data.value: Where the pre-filled numbers come from — a project variant or the default values.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_DATEI_ERL
data.value: The file whose reading rules are set here.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_ROLLE_ERL
data.value: What the series stands for: load, PV generation or purchase price. It determines the available units.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_TRENNZEICHEN_ERL
data.value: The character that separates the columns of the file.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_DEZIMAL_ERL
data.value: The character that separates the integer and fractional part in the file's numbers.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_KODIERUNG_ERL
data.value: The character encoding of the file; it is not guessed.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_KOPFZEILE_ERL
data.value: Does the first data row carry the column names instead of values?

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_UEBERSPRINGEN_ERL
data.value: How many rows before the header row are skipped.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_ZEITANGABE_ERL
data.value: Is the time in one timestamp column or in separate date and time columns?

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_ZSTEMPELSPALTE_ERL
data.value: The column holding the complete timestamp.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_ZSTEMPELFORMAT_ERL
data.value: The format of the timestamp; empty means the standard format.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_DATUMSPALTE_ERL
data.value: The column holding the date; it applies only with separate date and time.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_DATUMFORMAT_ERL
data.value: The format of the date; empty means the standard format.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_UHRZEITSPALTE_ERL
data.value: The column holding the time of day; it applies only with separate date and time.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_UHRZEITFORMAT_ERL
data.value: The format of the time of day; empty means the standard format.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_WERTSPALTE_ERL
data.value: The column holding the measured value of the series.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_ZEITZONE_ERL
data.value: The time zone the file's time stamps are given in.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_INTERVALL_ERL
data.value: Whether the timestamp denotes the start or the end of the interval. 'Automatic (detect from the series)' decides it from the first timestamp of the file: a series with end-of-interval stamps starts exactly one interval after midnight of 1 January.

data.name: KI_DLG_SZR_EINHEIT_ERL
data.value: The unit of the values in the file; the available ones depend on the role of the series.

data.name: KI_DLG_SGA_ZEITINTERVALL_ERL
data.value: The time resolution an imported file is stored with — hourly or quarter-hourly.

data.name: KI_DLG_SGA_GEWAEHLT_ERL
data.value: The identifier of the selected catalogue row; it decides what the delete button affects.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_NAME_ERL
data.value: The name of the storage unit; it also appears in the fleet listing of the view.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_KAPAZITAET_ERL
data.value: The nominal capacity of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_LADELEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The maximum charging power of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_ENTLADELEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The maximum discharging power of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_LADEWIRKUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The charging efficiency of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_ENTLADEWIRKUNGSGRAD_ERL
data.value: The discharging efficiency of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_SOC_MIN_ERL
data.value: The lower state-of-charge limit of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_SOC_MAX_ERL
data.value: The upper state-of-charge limit of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_SOC_START_ERL
data.value: The state of charge of this unit at the start of the run.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_PEAK_RESERVE_ERL
data.value: The energy this unit holds back for peak shaving.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_HILFSVERBRAUCH_ERL
data.value: The permanent auxiliary consumption of the unit on the AC side.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_GRENZVERSCHLEISS_ERL
data.value: The marginal wear cost per discharged kilowatt-hour.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_EIGENE_KOSTEN_ERL
data.value: Does this unit use its own cost rates instead of the study's?

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_INVEST_FIX_ERL
data.value: The fixed share of this unit's investment.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_INVEST_KAPAZITAET_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related share of this unit's investment.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_INVEST_LEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The power-related share of this unit's investment.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_OPEX_FIX_ERL
data.value: The fixed annual operating cost of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_OPEX_KAPAZITAET_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related annual operating cost of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_OPEX_LEISTUNG_ERL
data.value: The power-related annual operating cost of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_DURCHSATZKOSTEN_ERL
data.value: The cost per discharged kilowatt-hour of this unit.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_ERSATZINTERVALL_ERL
data.value: Service life of this unit: after how many years it is replaced; its linear residual value follows from it. 0 = the service life from the service life table for battery storage.

data.name: KI_DLG_FLE_RESTWERT_ERL
data.value: Device data, no longer used in the calculation: a fixed residual value of this unit that is only kept on record. The net present value derives the residual value linearly from the service life (replacement interval).

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_LASTQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the electricity demand comes from: the EPOS calculation or an imported file.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_PVQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the PV generation comes from: the EPOS simulation, a file, or not at all.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_PREISQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the purchase price comes from: the EPOS electricity tariff, a file, or a price profile.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_MODELLJAHR_ERL
data.value: Maps an imported file's time axis onto the EPOS model year; needed as soon as a file and an EPOS series stand side by side.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_INVESTQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the investment cost comes from: this dialogue or the cost module.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_BETRIEBSQUELLE_ERL
data.value: Where the operating cost comes from: this dialogue or the cost module.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_INVEST_KW_ERL
data.value: The power-related share of the investment; it can be entered only with the source 'In the dialogue'.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_INVEST_KWH_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related share of the investment; it can be entered only with the source 'In the dialogue'.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_BETRIEB_KW_ERL
data.value: The power-related annual operating cost of the study.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_BETRIEB_KWH_ERL
data.value: The capacity-related annual operating cost of the study.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_BETRIEB_ENTLADEN_ERL
data.value: The operating cost per discharged kilowatt-hour.

data.name: KI_DLG_SPA2_LEISTUNGSPREIS_ERL

data.value:
EPOS-Plan – supplied report templates
EPOS-Plan renews these files at every start. For your own templates, place a copy in the parent folder or use “New template…”.
This folder holds the standard template, the short report and the building kit with all placeholders (each in German and English) as well as the Excel standard workbook with sheet markers. A copied file may keep its read-only flag; it can be cleared in the file properties. EPOS-Plan leaves other files in this folder untouched but does not offer them as templates.
